nodes.label: Storage Warning Banner
nodes.description: Fixed-position #storageWarning div (line 1742) containing warning icon, text message ('Storage full — New plants won't be saved...'), and close button. Initially hidden via style="display:none". Positioned above bottom nav at z-index 90.

nodes.label: .storage-warning CSS
nodes.description: Complete CSS rule set (lines 922-972) for .storage-warning and child selectors: .storage-warning-icon, .storage-warning-text, .storage-warning-close, .storage-warning-close:hover. Fixed bottom positioning, amber warning colors (#fef3c7 bg, #92400e text), border radius 16px, slide-in animation.

nodes.label: _storageFull Flag
nodes.description: Module-scoped boolean (line 1822, let _storageFull = false) that tracks localStorage quota exhaustion. Acts as circuit-breaker: when true, save() returns early to stop hammering a full store.

nodes.label: save() Storage Quota Handler
nodes.description: Storage quota handling inside save() (lines 1823-1834): early-return guard checks _storageFull flag; try/catch wraps localStorage.setItem calls; catch block sets _storageFull=true, shows #storageWarning banner, logs error to console.

nodes.label: dismissStorageWarning()
nodes.description: Public function (lines 1835-1838) that hides the #storageWarning banner (sets display:none) and resets _storageFull=false to allow retry after user frees space. Exposed on window object (line 1957).

nodes.label: Storage Quota Warning Feature
nodes.description: Complete localStorage quota-exhaustion feature: detects QuotaExceededError in save(), shows amber warning banner, gates writes via _storageFull flag, allows manual dismiss to retry. Prevents silent data loss when localStorage is full.
